newsitem.title: USA: Torotel sees breakeven second quarter.
newsitem.headline: Torotel sees breakeven second quarter.

text.p: Torotel Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings to break even in its second quarter.
Earlier the company reported breakeven per share results for the fiscal first quarter compared with $0.06 a share in the year ago quarter.
Linking computer systems at two Torotel units, a nine to 12 month process, is expected to pressure earnings, the company said.

"Because we believe this and other actions will result in one-time charges, it is difficult to give an accurate reading on the outlook for fiscal 1997's performance," chief executive Dale Sizemore Jr said in a news release. "At this time, we expect to see another breakeven period for the second quarter."
Sizemore also said the company is conducting a review of its Torotel Products unit and expects to announce changes in the coming months.
"Torotel's performance continues to be less than satisfactory," Sizemore said. "Fortunately with the help of our new chief operating officer, Chris Hughes, this situation is being addressed."
